title: Local length of a finite marking
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $P=(C,D,i)$ a multipointed $k$-curve [def-trf-multipointed-curve], and $x\in C$. Give every local ring $\mathcal O_{D,d}$ its canonical $k$-vector-space structure through the structure morphism, using the local scalar map [def-trf-orgogozo-induction-data]. Define $\ell_{P,x}=\sum_{d\in D,\ i(d)=x}\dim_k\mathcal O_{D,d}$. There is at most one summand since $i$ is a closed immersion. The empty sum is zero. In the case used here, when $D$ is finite over $k$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], this is the dimension of the local Artinian factor of its coordinate algebra supported at $x$, or zero when $x\notin i(D)$. It is not the dimension of the scheme-theoretic fibre of $D\to C$.
